description.text:
A top-four deck of the Junior Division at the 2017 World Championships, the best showing of the popular Decidueye-GX deck at its last Worlds before Forest of Giant Plants rotated out. Golisopod-GX attacks from the Active Spot while Decidueye-GX stays on the Bench and picks off the opponent's Pokémon with Feather Arrow. The 2017 World Championships were held at the Anaheim Convention Center in Anaheim, California, from 18 to 20 August 2017.

Pokémon sold it as a 2017 World Championships deck: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box and a pin. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
